changes: Removed city Basel (CH): trucksimulator.wiki.gg Switzerland page states 'There are three cities in Switzerland featured in Euro Truck Simulator 2' (after the 1.50 rework); fandom wiki lists only Bern, Genève, Zürich; ProMods forum users note Basel appears only in ProMods; map-data villages list records Basel as an inaccessible village label.
Removed city Lausanne (CH): same evidence, only three Swiss cities in vanilla (Bern, Genève, Zürich); no wiki city page for Lausanne found.

Rewired Basel edges: Basel-Zürich + Basel-Strasbourg merged into Zürich-Strasbourg (227 km, A3/A35; wiki Strasbourg page says the A35 runs south toward Zürich); Basel-Bern + Basel-Strasbourg merged into Bern-Strasbourg (238 km, low confidence).

Rewired Lausanne edges: Bern-Lausanne + Lausanne-Genève merged into Bern-Genève (160 km); Bern-Lausanne + Lausanne-Torino merged into Bern-Torino (360 km via the Great St Bernard tunnel, T2 added to base game in 1.50 per wiki T2 page; confidence medium).
Genève-Torino: confidence raised low->medium and road labelled Mont Blanc tunnel/T1: SCS showed the Mont Blanc tunnel in Switzerland rework footage (gamepressure 'Roof of Europe' article).

Candidates rejected: Villach and Grödig (AT) not added; wiki says Austria has six accessible cities (Wien, Linz, Salzburg, Graz, Klagenfurt, Innsbruck), Villach not on it. Airolo and Vaduz (CH/LI) not added; only three Swiss cities in vanilla and no source shows Liechtenstein having a city (radio tool includes ProMods).
Graz and Klagenfurt notes: restored the base-game 1.11.1 origin, which the fandom wiki summary supports (1.11.1 brought Austria to six cities).

Confirmed: Austria rework shipped in 1.44 (SCS blog previews Feb/Mar 2022); Switzerland rework in 1.50 (14 May 2024). No city name, DLC or coordinate changes needed for the remaining 9 cities. Liechtenstein has no city.
